description: [DREAL ARA] Réseau de chaleur et de froid : infrastructure de distribution en 2017 pour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. A heat network (also known as district heating) is an installation that distributes heat produced by one or more boilers to several users via a set of heat transport pipes (hot water pipes) and exchangers (also known as substations). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL ARA] Heat and cold network: distribution infrastructure in 2017 for Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Réseau de froid, Réseau de chaleur. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
